facts: **Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these are worth explaining further. Fennel seeds contain compounds that relax the muscles lining your gut, which is why chewing a small spoonful after a heavy meal can ease that tight, bloated feeling within minutes. Tart cherry juice is one of the few natural sources of melatonin, and studies link it to calmer nerve signaling at night — that's part of why it's been used for restless legs and disrupted sleep. Sardines are packed with omega-3s that your brain uses to build the receptors involved in mood regulation, so a regular serving can genuinely support how steady you feel day to day. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what actually helps yours.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organ function, and small daily habits so you don't need a medical degree to understand your own body. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
